name: kiran-nonwovens
description: One Node app for kirannonwovens.com: the API (server/) also serves the built website (client/dist).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm run smoke --prefix client
